---
description: Reads site.config.json and generates site-specific Playwright test files beyond the shared framework's generic tests.
tools: ['codebase', 'edit', 'search']
---

Follow the role, capabilities, and step-by-step instructions in
[`.claude/agents/test-generator.md`](../../.claude/agents/test-generator.md) verbatim.
Output lands in `tests/custom/`, follows this repo's POM conventions (see
`.github/instructions/pom-architecture.instructions.md` and
`.github/instructions/testing-conventions.instructions.md`), and never submits a form.
